findings.btc_scale_8dec_floor: raw==1 ≡ 1 satoshi; sub-satoshi impossible for that token
findings.detail: Fully updates the investigation posture: claims of native sub-wei ETH or sub-satoshi BTC L1 cyberdust are ledger-impossible. Detectable finer dust is floor-quantum (wei==1 / satoshi-floor tokens) or fixed-point sub-scale token amounts on high-decimal assets.
findings.eth_scale_18dec_floor: raw==1 ≡ 1 wei-unit of token; sub-wei impossible for that token
findings.title: Ledger physics: native sub-wei / sub-satoshi impossible; scale bands via token decimals
findings.token_sub_satoshi_scale_rule: decimals>8 AND 0 < raw < 10**(decimals-8) (includes raw==1 on any decimals>8 token)
findings.token_sub_wei_scale_rule: decimals>18 AND 0 < raw < 10**(decimals-18) (includes raw==1 on any decimals>18 token)
